baseline.scope: Read current ROOT bytes including authorized pre-existing WIP; snapshot before atomic-publication change

behavior: Same-directory unique wx temporary file, complete write, sync, close, then exclusive hard-link publication under existing shared lock
Pre-publication failure leaves no pseudo-freeze, retains temporary bytes plus best-effort exclusive failure receipt, preserves original/aggregate errors
link is commit boundary: successful complete final is never overwritten or rolled back; later cleanup failures return committed freeze with explicit warning and retained evidence
SIGKILL retains temporary bytes and owner lock for manual reconciliation; no automatic stale recovery
limits: Native multi-process/filesystem fixtures; readiness/data/model/legacy gates are explicitly synthetic stubs
No real freeze, model call, build, HTTP, training, deployment, commit or push
No old immutable freeze/results/correction archive altered
No power-loss durability or cross-filesystem publication claim
